components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Gold mono CTA used for quote requests.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--gold, #c59a53); color: var(--ink, #121416); padding: 12px 16px; border: none; border-radius: 0; font-family: "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-transform: uppercase; transition: background 0.2s, color 0.2s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--bronze, #7a5d2f); color: var(--fg, #f3f1eb); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--gold, #c59a53); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { background: transparent; color: var(--fg, #f3f1eb); padding: 12px 16px; border: 1px solid var(--line, #2b3033); border-radius: 0; font-family: "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-transform: uppercase; transition: color 0.2s, border-color 0.2s; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { color: var(--gold, #c59a53); border-color: var(--gold, #c59a53); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--gold, #c59a53); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Nav Link
components.css: .ds-nav-link { color: var(--fg, #f3f1eb); font-family: "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase; text-decoration: none; transition: color 0.2s; } .ds-nav-link:hover { color: var(--gold, #c59a53); } .ds-nav-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--gold, #c59a53); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Quote form field on raised charcoal.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; } .ds-field-label { font-family: "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--fg-muted, #b3aea4); } .ds-input { background: var(--bg-raised, #111417); color: var(--fg, #f3f1eb); border: 1px solid var(--line, #2b3033); border-radius: 0; padding: 12px 14px; font-family: "IBM Plex Sans", Helvetica Neue, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--gold, #c59a53); outline-offset: 0; border-color: var(--gold, #c59a53); }

narrative.overview:
Thrun Design Co.’s public surfaces feel like a quiet studio after hours: charcoal planes, cream ink, and a single warm gold used sparingly like a brass rule on an editorial spread. The system favors restraint over spectacle — composition, typography, and honest copy do the persuasion work.

Density is editorial, not dashboard. Sections breathe with large vertical rhythm; borders are hairline charcoal; corners stay sharp (0 radius). Imagery is desaturated landscape and architectural atmosphere, never stock-smiley lifestyle collage.
keyCharacteristics: Near-black charcoal field with cream type and rare gold accents
Libre Baskerville display + IBM Plex Sans/Mono for body and labels
Zero border-radius; hairline rules instead of cards-as-decoration
Persuasion path always ends at the quote request

rules.name: The One Gold Rule
rules.body: Gold appears on primary CTAs, brand lockup emphasis, and selective hover — never as a wash, gradient field, or decorative glow.

rules.name: The No-Purple Rule
rules.body: Do not introduce purple, indigo, neon, or glow accents. Stay in charcoal / cream / gold / bronze.

rules.name: The Brand-First Display Rule
rules.body: On branded first viewports, the Thrun name/lockup must compete with — not surrender to — the headline.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: No decorative drop shadows. If a surface needs separation, change tone or draw a 1px line.

rules.name: The Zero-Radius Rule
rules.body: Do not introduce rounded-full pills, soft cards, or floating media tiles unless a platform control absolutely requires it.

dos: Do keep gold rare and purposeful (primary CTA + brand emphasis).
Do label concept portfolio work as concepts — never as shipped client proof.
Do push the persuasion path toward /quote with clear reply expectations.
Do preserve Libre + Plex + zero radius as the identity triad.
donts: Don't invent testimonials, metrics, logos, or awards.
Don't use purple gradients, glow, soft UI pills, or dashboard chrome on marketing surfaces.
Don't fill the first viewport with stats, schedules, or secondary promos.
Don't present inset hero media cards — hero imagery stays full-bleed / edge-dominant.
